trigger_condition: An inactive persisted flag protects a legacy view through the inverse !flag decorator form.
defect_mechanism: waffle_flag strips the ! prefix but reuses flag_is_active directly instead of negating it, so an inactive flag makes the inverse guard deny the view.
propagation_path: The request enters the waffle_flag wrapper; direct flag evaluation correctly returns False; the faulty inverse branch stores False as active; the common denial branch raises Http404.
failure_manifestation: The legacy endpoint returns 404 even though the persisted feature is inactive and the inverse guard should allow the view.
reference_repair_behavior: Negate the direct flag_is_active result in the inverse decorator branch.
